erp.description: Finance / ERP export (e-conomic-like). Sales invoices with lines, customer and product masters, chart of accounts and cost ledger entries. Base currency DKK.

fields.name: legal name
fields.country: country in Danish (Danmark/Sverige/Tyskland) -> market via value_mappings

fields.exchange_rate: DKK per 1 unit of invoice currency, fixed per invoice
fields.document_type: invoice | credit_note (credit notes carry negative amounts)
fields.credited_invoice_number: for credit notes: the invoice being credited

fields.unit_cost_dkk/total_cost_dkk: cost of sales in DKK (materials, parts, subcontractors; technician salaries are payroll, not cost of sales)

fields.type: revenue | cost of sales | personnel | opex

ledger_entries.note: Contains cost postings not generated by sales invoices: the monthly payroll journal (company totals, no department split) and operating expenses. Revenue and cost of sales are derived from invoices, not from the ledger.

crm.description: CRM export (HubSpot-like): users (owners), companies, deals, activities and a property change history. Contains pipeline history from September 2024.

fields.active/archived_at: archived users keep ownership of old records

fields.name: as typed by sales (may differ from ERP legal name)

fields.expected_close_date: forecast close for open deals; may lie in the past (slipped)
fields.amount_company_currency: deal value converted to DKK by the CRM
fields.market: English country name, sometimes blank (see market fallback)

payroll.description: Group payroll export (Danløn-like), all countries, monthly pay slips in local currency.

fields.base_salary: prorated for partial months, local currency
fields.employer_cost: gross_pay + employer pension + employer social contributions
fields.fx_rate_to_dkk: rate used by payroll for DKK reporting

mappings.description: Cross-system identity and value mappings maintained by the business (not by any source system).

crm_company_erp_customer.note: Many-to-one possible (duplicate CRM records). Not every customer is mapped.

employee_crm_user.note: Some CRM users have no payroll record (former staff, system users).

value_mappings.note: Canonical market and product category per system label.

currencies.canonical: DKK. All aggregated money values returned by the runtime are DKK.
currencies.erp: revenue_dkk = invoice_lines.net_amount * invoices.exchange_rate; costs are already DKK.
currencies.crm: value_dkk = deals.amount_company_currency (the CRM's own DKK conversion).
currencies.note: Each system converts with its own rates; values from different systems can differ slightly. Source-currency amounts are kept on record-level results.

dates.erp_revenue: invoice_date (credit notes on their own date)
dates.crm_open_at_date: created_at <= date and (closed_at blank or closed_at > date); stage at a past date is not recorded

markets.crm_deals_fallback: deals.market -> else companies.country of the deal's company -> else deals.deal_currency (each market trades in its own currency: DKK=DK, SEK=SE, EUR=DE). Results report market_source for transparency.
markets.erp_ledger: ledger_entries.department where present; payroll journal has no department

product_categories.erp: products.product_group_number: 10 Equipment (pumps and systems), 20 Components (spare parts), 30 Service (service agreements, technician hours, commissioning)
product_categories.crm: deals.product_category: Pumps & Systems / Spare Parts Agreement / Service Contract; blank -> null

metrics.revenue: sum of invoice line net amounts in DKK incl. credit notes, by invoice_date
metrics.personnel_costs_erp: ledger accounts of type personnel (monthly payroll journal)
metrics.operating_profit: revenue - cost_of_sales - personnel costs - other operating costs; operating_margin = operating_profit / revenue
metrics.avg_discount_pct: 1 - revenue / list value (quantity * unit_price before discount)
metrics.pipeline_created: count and DKK value of deals with created_at in the period
metrics.win_rate: won / (won + lost) by count for deals with closed_at in the period; value_win_rate uses DKK value
metrics.renewals: deals with deal_type Renewal; excluded from pipeline and win rate unless include_renewals=true
metrics.headcount_point_in_time: employees whose employment_start <= date <= employment_end (or no end)
metrics.headcount_average_monthly: average number of employees with a payroll entry per month in the period
metrics.base_salary_change: like-for-like: employees employed the whole of both months; change in LOCAL currency (excludes FX), aggregated with from-month DKK weights

data_quality: Names differ between systems (legal names in ERP, typed names in CRM, spelling variants for people).
Optional fields are often blank: loss_reason, industry, country, market, product_category, VAT number, work email, ledger department.
Duplicate CRM company records exist; the mapping links both to one ERP customer.
Some ERP customers are not in the CRM, and a few existing ones are not mapped.
Archived CRM users can still own old records.
Open deals may have expected_close_date in the past.
Date coverage differs slightly between systems (see meta_describe_sources); the CRM holds pipeline history before the ERP/payroll period and its extract can include records a day past their cut-off.

notes: Operating costs are company-level; the payroll journal is not split by market.
